assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering conditions are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.statement_zh: 公开场地包未提供审定控规条件、道路红线、权属、市政管线与工程约束。
assumptions.impact: Land-use, road-area and building-footprint geometries are design concepts only and must not be used as statutory controls.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Replace or recalculate affected layers after organizer-issued control data is registered.

assumptions.statement: The unchanged repository provisional SITE_BOUNDARY is a rough geometry inferred from announcement text and an approximate 11.4 sq km area.
assumptions.statement_zh: 本包原样使用仓库临时 SITE_BOUNDARY；该范围由公告文字四至与约11.4平方公里面积推导。
assumptions.impact: All derived areas and ratios support intake review and concept comparison, not official redline or precise statutory area claims.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Regenerate every design layer and metric from the registered official boundary when supplied.

assumptions.statement: The three unchanged KEY_AREA polygons are rough locational proxies and are not official detailed-design boundaries.
assumptions.statement_zh: 本包原样使用三个临时 KEY_AREA 多边形；它们仅是位置代理，不是官方重点片区红线。
assumptions.impact: Station relationships to key areas are conceptual; precise inclusion, adjacency and key-area area claims remain unverified.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Recheck station placement and key-area metrics after official polygons are registered.

assumptions.statement: Existing housing stock, unit counts, rents, affordability, tenure and occupancy data are not available.
assumptions.statement_zh: 现状住房存量、套数、租金、可负担性、租期与入住数据均未提供。
assumptions.impact: The four footprints are spatial prototypes only; no housing supply, rent or affordability outcome is claimed.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Establish a privacy-preserving housing baseline and an audited operator dataset before quantifying outcomes.

assumptions.statement: Official protection boundaries and construction-control zones for Qinghuayuan Station and Jing-Zhang railway heritage are not registered in the site package.
assumptions.statement_zh: 场地包未登记清华园车站及京张铁路遗产的正式保护范围与建设控制地带几何。
assumptions.impact: No submitted geometry may be interpreted as a heritage boundary; detailed siting requires a heritage impact check.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Overlay registered heritage geometries and rerun conflict review before detailed design.

assumptions.statement: AI does not decide eligibility, rent or housing allocation and does not score individuals or households; every service requires human review, a non-AI path and an exit mechanism.
assumptions.statement_zh: AI 不决定资格、租金或住房分配，不对个人或家庭评分；所有服务均须提供人工复核、无 AI 路径与退出机制。
assumptions.impact: Scenario implementation must separate explanation and coordination support from consequential decisions.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Audit service specifications, consent records, appeals and offline fallback before operation.

assumptions.statement: The three phases express implementation order, not committed dates, budgets, ownership agreements or construction approvals.
assumptions.statement_zh: 三期图层仅表达实施先后，不代表已承诺日期、资金、权属协议或建设审批。
assumptions.impact: Delivery scope and timing remain subject to statutory approval, land and operator agreements, funding and utility capacity.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Convert concept phases into a governed project list only after responsible entities and dependencies are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: The proposed 90-day sequence is a test protocol, not an authorized schedule; no operator, site permission, participant cohort, procurement, insurance, budget or field result is confirmed.
assumptions.statement_zh: 拟议 90 天序列只是测试协议，不是获授权日程；运营主体、场地许可、参与者、采购、保险、预算和现场结果均未确认。
assumptions.impact: Only protocol completeness and synthetic desktop checks may be reported as known; capacity, cost, service quality, safety performance and public acceptance remain unknown.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: A future authorized sponsor must register approvals, RACI acceptance, baseline, participant safeguards, quotes and stop authority before any field window.

assumptions.statement: The three industry-validation protocols define proposed baselines, instruments, acceptance and stop logic but contain no observed field measurements or certified conclusions.
assumptions.statement_zh: 三项产业验证只定义拟议基线、仪器、验收与停止逻辑，不包含现场观测值或认证结论。
assumptions.impact: Protocol thresholds cannot be described as achieved performance, and site-dependent acoustic, safety, accessibility and device results remain unknown.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Qualified reviewers must set applicable thresholds, approve a site and sample, preserve raw records and sign the result before any performance claim.

assumptions.statement: Links to northern communities, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing E-Town and the Jing-Jin-Ji network describe exchange objects and decision boundaries only.
assumptions.statement_zh: 北部社区、未来科学城、怀柔科学城、经开区和京津冀接口只描述交换对象与决定边界。
assumptions.impact: No partnership, route, service integration, commuting flow, housing supply, investment or institutional commitment is claimed.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Replace each conceptual interface with authorized counterpart roles, applicable rules, data agreements and independently confirmed receiving paths.

assumptions.statement: Brand stewardship, service levels, annual Relay Week and international communication checks are proposed governance assets without an appointed steward or recurring budget.
assumptions.statement_zh: 品牌保管、服务等级、年度居业接力周和国际传播检查均为治理建议，尚无受任保管者或持续预算。
assumptions.impact: The package can define status labels, duties and stop conditions but cannot claim an operating programme, response time or annual event.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: An authorized entity must appoint accountable roles, approve resources, publish service clocks and obtain event permissions before operation.
